topics.name: UX Copywriting
topics.description: The craft of writing intuitive interface copy that guides users through a digital experience seamlessly and efficiently.
conventions: Prioritize clarity and usability over cleverness.
Use active voice and front-load important information.

topics.name: Content Design
topics.description: The strategic process of using data and evidence to give users the information they need, exactly when they need it, in the most optimal format.
conventions: Design content as a structural component of the interface rather than an afterthought.
Use data and research to answer user questions exactly when they arise.

topics.name: Monetization & Conversion UX
topics.description: The intersection of user experience and business goals, focusing on optimizing interfaces to encourage user action, purchases, subscriptions, or upgrades.
conventions: Balance business objectives with user trust and autonomy.
Highlight value clearly without resorting to deceptive or manipulative dark patterns.

topics.name: AI Translation & Localization
topics.description: Adapting digital products for different languages and cultures, increasingly utilizing artificial intelligence to scale global accessibility.
conventions: Provide contextual clues and glossaries for automated or human translation.
Design interface components to accommodate text expansion or contraction across languages.

topics.name: AI Writing Assistance
topics.description: The integration of large language models and artificial intelligence tools to augment the writing process, generate ideas, and scale content production.
conventions: Utilize AI as a drafting and ideation co-pilot, not a final arbiter of copy.
Always enforce a human review process to ensure empathy, contextual accuracy, and brand alignment.

topics.name: User Psychology & Cognitive Load
topics.description: The study of how users perceive, process, and act on information, applied to minimize mental effort in digital interfaces.
conventions: Reduce cognitive friction by breaking complex tasks into smaller, manageable steps.
Leverage familiar interaction patterns to align with users' existing mental models.

topics.name: Accessibility & Inclusive Design
topics.description: The practice of ensuring digital copy and content structures are usable by everyone, regardless of physical ability, neurodiversity, or background.
conventions: Write in plain, accessible language, aiming for a broad reading comprehension level.
Structure content with clear, descriptive headings to aid screen reader navigation.
